criteria.contract: Add the scope of the features adopted from the other reference games (Sengokushi SE and Sengoku Jidai Light/DX; integration proposal section 26, Z1-Z14) to the affected existing items without changing the 60 items or weights.
Re-rate only the affected items downward in proportion to the added scope; record old and new percentages, the added scope and the reason for each item.
Record the total change as an excluded reassessment, never as earned implementation progress; no code, tests or assets change.
Re-freeze the next implementation stage (NPC purpose) on the fifth re-rated baseline before its code exists, keeping its per-item target increments.
Regenerate the progress view and pass the existing progress and approval-batch checks.
